settings.mcpSaveSubDirHelpContent:
Subdirectory Format

Supported tokens:
  {yyyy}       → Year (e.g. 2026)
  {mm}         → Month (e.g. 03)
  {dd}         → Day (e.g. 17)
  {yyyy-mm-dd} → Date (e.g. 2026-03-17)
  {HH}         → Hour (24h, e.g. 14)
  {MM}         → Minute (e.g. 05)
  {ss}         → Second (e.g. 30)
  {project}    → Project name
  {severity}   → Severity level (info/success/warning/error, default: general)
  {type}       → Document type (note/plan/report etc, default: note)

Examples:
  {yyyy-mm-dd}           → 2026-03-17/file.md
  {project}/{yyyy-mm-dd} → MyProject/2026-03-17/file.md
  {type}/{yyyy-mm-dd}    → plan/2026-03-17/file.md
  {yyyy}/{mm}            → 2026/03/file.md

Both / and \ are supported and auto-converted for your OS.
